column1: # ACTION TD (p230) - SLUG_RE fixed and the dotted names re-gated.
# LIMB 2 FIRES on the letter of the falsifier: 0 cells disagree with their repository.
# But the falsifier's phrasing - "the truncation cost only coverage" - is WRONG in two ways
# THE FIX. p228: ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*?)(?=[)\s`,.;:'"\]]|$)   LAZY, terminator holds `.`
# plus: a trailing `.git` is a clone URL's suffix, not part of the name (T230-1), and a
# sentence-final period is STRIPPED in post, which is a different operation from stopping at one.
# 25 dotted names now harvest. 18 carry a grant readable first-hand. 0 published cells wrong.
# WHAT p230 ADDS OVER p229's HAND RECOVERY, stated precisely because p229 did much of this:
#   p229's sw-recovered-slugs recovered 8 of these names by hand and celled nakafa.com as
#   NONCOMMERCIAL-NOT-OSI. p230 does not re-discover that. It adds:
#   1. THE HARVESTER. 25 names, found by the instrument every pass, with 33 controls and a
#      make target - not 8 names found by hand once.
#   2. AN INTRA-PASS CONTRADICTION. p229's sw-grant-ladder-reach carries processing/p5,
#      dmitry-viskov/pylti1 and jdolny/OneRoster as "slug does not resolve at all" while
#      sw-recovered-slugs, written the same hour, carries their TRUE names with grants.
#      Both tables are internally right - the first is keyed on the truncated string - and
#      nothing in it says so. A reader of the first alone drops a usable component.
#   3. THE INSTRUMENT NAMED. nakafa.com's token NONCOMMERCIAL-NOT-OSI / NOASSERTION resolves
#      on a first-hand read to "Nakafa Source Available License 1.0", effective 2026-04-24,
#      (c) PT NAKAFA TEKNO KREATIF, whose own text reads "This is not an open-source license."
#      A token tells a studio not to build; a named instrument is what counsel reviews.
#   4. TWO FORK DIRECTIONS, settled by the copyright line - see td-fork-direction.
